newsitem.title: UK: First Leisure up amid talk of new chief.
newsitem.headline: First Leisure up amid talk of new chief.

text.p: Shares in First Leisure Corp Plc rose sharply on Wednesday following a newspaper report that Michael Grade may become full-time executive chairman.
The shares jumped 16-1/2p to 357-1/2p by 0825 GMT.
The Financial Times newspaper said that Grade is expected to make an announcement soon. The former chief executive of Channel 4 television resigned from his post earlier this week.

Grade is already non-executive chairman of First Leisure. On Tuesday, the Financial Times reported that Grade would be named today as chairman of "a leading quoted entertainment company" following his resignation from Channel 4.
"We were tipped off yesterday," said one leading industry analyst who declined to be named. "There was obviously going to be a change but I wasn't expecting it," he said.
